provenance.annotation: Manually authored 2026-10-12 from page titles and topic descriptions; page-level relevance (all 12 excerpts on a target page eligible), not independently judged passage qrels. No query was copied from corpus text. An exploratory check, not evidence for a default change.
provenance.split: Unique page titles in demo/data/passages-2000.json in corpus order; title index modulo 4 = 0 is held-out evaluation candidate; remaining titles are transform-fit-only training corpus. Query and held-out candidate vectors are never used to fit preprocessing.

conditions: Fresh local headless Chromium encoder for questions; Node exhaustive cosine on committed f32 corpus vectors promoted to Float64; no IndexedDB timing or p95 claim. Query search time excludes browser model encoding and one-time fit/preparation. Single process, no confidence interval.
